MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Kitchen Hand- Ceduna District Health Services



 Apply now
 Job no: 943531

 Work type: Full time, Part time

 Location: Eyre and Western

 Categories: Catering and Hospitality





 

Eyre and Far North Local Health Network, Ceduna District Health Services 

Ongoing Full Time or Part Time (hours are negotiable)

Salary: WHD2 $1,204.70 - $1,226.60 per week (pro rata) + Regional Allowance + Superannuation + Leave Loading + Salary Sacrifice Benefits

About the Role

Join the friendly team at Ceduna Hospital as a Kitchen Hand and play a vital role in supporting patient care behind the scenes. This ongoing opportunity is available on a full-time or part-time basis, offering job security, flexibility, and the chance to be part of a close-knit health service that truly values its people.

In this hands-on role, you will contribute to the preparation, service and delivery of meals to patients, residents and staff, helping ensure a safe, clean and welcoming environment. You may also support other areas of the health unit such as laundry and housekeeping, providing variety in your day and strengthening teamwork across services.

This is a great opportunity for someone seeking stable employment, flexible hours, and meaningful work that makes a difference in the Ceduna community.

About You

Do you enjoy working as part of a team and take pride in contributing to a supportive, respectful workplace?

Are you reliable, flexible and willing to work across kitchen, laundry and housekeeping areas as needed?

Do you have good communication skills and enjoy providing friendly, respectful service to people from all backgrounds?

Are you keen to learn new skills, follow clear instructions and maintain high standards of hygiene and safety?

If you have answered yes to the above, we would love to hear from you!

How Will You Contribute?

Assist with the preparation, plating, service and delivery of meals in a timely and efficient manner.

Support safe and effective kitchen operations by maintaining cleanliness, handling stock and using equipment correctly.

Work collaboratively with colleagues to support the smooth day-to-day operation of the health unit.

Participate in training and follow food safety, infection control and workplace health and safety standards.

About Us

With its ancient outback landscapes, boutique vineyards, oyster farms and Australia's best-kept-secret surf coast, Eyre and Far North will inspire and energise you.

The Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN) is responsible for the planning and delivery of hospital and health services over 337,626 square kilometres, taking in the Eyre Peninsula, western part of South Australia and north to Coober Pedy. We are one of the largest LHNs by area in Australia and communities include Ceduna, Cleve, Coober Pedy, Cowell, Cummins, Elliston, Kimba, Oodnadatta, Port Lincoln, Streaky Bay, Tumby Bay and Wudinna.

Services include acute care, medical, accident and emergency, surgery, birthing and midwifery, specialist consultancy, renal dialysis, chemotherapy, transfusions, rehabilitation, residential and community aged care, respite care, transitional care packages, Aboriginal health, mental health, allied health, community health, community nursing, palliative care, community home support packages and home modifications.

Click here to learn more about living and working in Eyre and Far North Local Health Network.

Why Join Us

Make a real difference and feel like an important part of the community. Being part of Eyre & Far North means you will be supported both personally and professionally, can take advantage of education and training opportunities, will have access to flexible working hours and be part of an inter-professional approach to holistic health care.

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT year Click here more information

Wellbeing and counselling support - support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program

Relocation support - relocation reimbursement of up to $15,000 may be available to people relocating for this opportunity. More information available from SA Health Careers - Relocation support.

Paid leave including leave loading

Employee recognition - supportive and collaborative work environment where your contributions are valued and recognised.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

Applicant Information

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Check(s)

National Police Certificate (NPC) for employment involving unsupervised contact with vulnerable groups required for this position (E.g. aged care employment or work involving vulnerable clients)

Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category B (indirect contact with blood or body substances)

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

For more information about the role please refer to the role description provided below. Job ref: 943531

Eligibility: Open to Everyone

In this role, you will work across the full software development lifecycle, analysing user and business requirements, designing, developing, testing and maintaining enterprise software applications using TypeScript, React, Microsoft Azure and C# (.NET).  Working closely with clients and internal teams, you will deliver secure, scalable and high-quality software solutions while contributing to innovative digital products that create meaningful business outcomes.  What you'll be doing   Analysing user requirements and business specifications to determine software design and programming solutions.  Designing, developing, testing, implementing and maintaining enterprise software applications.  Writing, reviewing and maintaining efficient, reliable and well-documented program code.  Developing full-stack software applications using TypeScript, React and C# (.NET).  Designing and delivering cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure, Azure Functions and event-driven architectures.  Developing, integrating and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services.  Modifying and enhancing existing software applications by implementing new functionality, resolving defects and improving performance.  Performing software testing, debugging, validation and troubleshooting to ensure software quality, reliability and security.  Preparing and maintaining software documentation, technical specifications and system design documentation.  Developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.  Participating in Agile software development activities including sprint planning, code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.  Collaborating directly with clients and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical software solutions.  Applying AI-assisted software development tools to support software design, implementation, testing and delivery while maintaining quality, security and maintainability.   You'll thrive here if you...   Have at least four years' relevant experience as a Developer Programmer or in a closely related software development role.  Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.  Have strong programming skills using TypeScript, React and C# (.NET).  Have experience designing, developing and maintaining enterprise software applications.  Have experience building and deploying cloud-based applications using Microsoft Azure.  Have experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services.  Have experience using Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions and CI/CD practices.  Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.  Can analyse business requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.  Communicate clearly and work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary project teams.  Demonstrate sound judgement when using AI-assisted development tools to improve software delivery while maintaining quality and security.   Why you'll love working at Kodez   Real career growth with opportunities to progress as we continue to scale.  Hybrid flexibility with the opportunity to work from home 2–3 days per week.  A supportive culture focused on wellbeing and psychological safety.  Competitive salary and meaningful employee benefits.  Professional Development Days to continue building your technical expertise.  Bonus leave, including your birthday off, with options to purchase additional leave or take extended breaks.  Diverse enterprise software projects using modern technologies.  A collaborative team that values curiosity, kindness, innovation and continuous learning.   At Kodez, we care about building software that matters—and about building teams that enjoy doing it.  About Company     At Kodez, we empower organisations of all sizes to deliver secure, high-impact digital outcomes through a blend of consulting, advisory, software development, cloud, data, AI and managed services.    From modernising enterprise platforms for ASX-listed organisations to rapidly developing innovative solutions for growing businesses, we combine deep technical expertise, agility and enterprise-grade reliability to deliver secure, scalable and practical technology solutions.    Our capabilities span Digital & Cloud, Identity & Security, Data & AI, enterprise software delivery and managed services, supporting organisations across Australia and New Zealand as they modernise and transform their digital environments. Flexiforce Australia is seeking Process Workers to join our team on both day and afternoon shifts at our clients Moss Vale NSW facility. This is a casual position with full-time ongoing hours that play a vital role in our clients manufacturing and assembly operations. As a Process Worker, you will be instrumental in ensuring production lines run smoothly and efficiently, directly contributing to the quality of products and the success of our client's business. This role offers stability, hands-on work, and the opportunity to be part of a dedicated manufacturing team.

What you'll be doing

1.	Operating and monitoring production line machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance
2.	Assembling products according to specifications and quality standards
3.	Inspecting finished products for quality control and identifying any defects or issues
4.	Preparing materials and components for processing stages
5.	Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in compliance with health and safety regulations
6.	Recording production data and reporting any equipment malfunctions or concerns to supervisors
7.	Following standard operating procedures and work instructions accurately
8.	Collaborating with team members to meet production targets and deadlines
9.	Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and providing feedback on processes

What we're looking for

1.	Previous experience in manufacturing, assembly or process work is highly desirable
2.	Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment and meet output targets
3.	Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards
4.	Reliability and punctuality, with flexibility to work day and afternoon shifts
5.	Physical capability to perform assembly work and operate machinery safely
6.	Willingness to follow instructions and work as part of a team
7.	Basic literacy and numeracy skills
8.	A valid working visa or Australian citizenship (where applicable)

What we offer

1.	Competitive hourly rates and ongoing employment security
2.	Shift allowances for afternoon shifts
3.	Safe, well-maintained working environment
4.	Opportunity to develop manufacturing and assembly skills
5.	Supportive team environment with experienced supervisors
6.	Career progression opportunities within the organisation
7.	Compliance with all relevant workplace entitlements and condition

Our client is a leading manufacturing company committed to delivering high-quality products and services. They pride themselves on maintaining a skilled workforce, fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement, and building long-term relationships with their employees. Our clients Moss Vale facility is a hub of production and assembly operations where teamwork and efficiency are at the heart of everything they do. Our client is dedicated to providing a supportive workplace where employees can develop their skills and contribute meaningfully to their success.

Ready to join our team? Apply now to become a Process Worker at Flexiforce Australia.

If you meet the criteria and are ready to start, we want to hear from you ASAP.
